line: Crowley's Six of Swords is the card for the second decan of Aquarius, with Mercury as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aquarius.

quotes.quote: The Six of Swords is called Science.
Mercury, in Aquarius, represents the celestial Energy

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The perfect balance of all mental and moral faculties, hardly won
